title: Badge Bonanza
description: Badges that give you neat perks!
body:
# <center>Badge Bonanza</center>
<center>
  
[![Support](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9d2c289db211cf86af07adb3d181b4ea5624296.png)](https://discord.gg/V3DTUtgGeG) [![StrawberryLib](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ContentSMP/Badges/refs/heads/main/strawberrylib/cozy_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/strawberrylib)

</center>


_This mod needs [Trinkets Updated](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets-updated) to work!_

Badges are a fun way to spice up your play style!

With this mod, you can find some Badges with the new Badge Flower that appears in the Flower Forest biome, or find Badges that spawn inside of certain chests or other stuff!

![A Badge Flower (resembling a real-life Sunflower) in between a field of Orange Tulips in a Flower Forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0059eb1848b13fdf59b1ca92c56d876ec2e5242.png)

The Badge Flower can also drop Badge Flower Seedlings to plant new ones!

_Badge Flowers are also Directional blocks, so you can place them any way you like! They also face the way you placed the seedling aswell._

## List of Badges
| Badge    | Function | Location |
| -------- | ------- | ------- |
| Cushioning | Reduces fall damage taken. | Badge Flower Drops |
| Dash | Increases movement speed on the ground. Gives an additional boost after sprinting for a while. | Badge Flower Drops |
| Dolphin Swim | Increases swimming speed. Holding and releasing the use key while swimming charges a boost that dashes you forward. | Shipwreck Chests |
| Flutter | Increases jump height. Hold Jump mid-air to float briefly. | Badge Flower Drops |
| Munch Charm | Lets you eat food faster. | Badge Flower Drops |
| Spider | Lets you climb on walls like a spider does. | Minecart Chests|
| Hunger Shield | Replaces your hunger bar with hearts. These hearts absorb any damage you take until you run out of hunger. | Trial Chamber Ominous Vaults |
| Obscurity | Hides your name tag and location on the Locator Bar. | Ocean Ruins Archaeology |
